test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On : 31 May 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.**

Admire
solution:
The correct answer is: **Appreciate.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Admire** means regard with respect or warm approval.

 *** • Example- ******I admire him for his courage.***

 
• Marked option **Appreciate** means recognising the full worth.

 *** • Example- ******I really appreciate everything you've done.***

 
• It is clear that **Admire** and** Appreciate **are **similar** in meaning.

Therefore the correct answer is **option 4.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Neglect** means the state of being uncared for.
 
• **Admonish** means advising or urging someone earnestly.
 
• **Forget** means fail to remember.
